title: OpenEconometrics Teaching Labs

labs.title: The Economic Question Comes First
labs.scope: Research questions, observational units, data types and study design.

labs.title: A First Look at Wages
labs.scope: Descriptive statistics, distributions and clear exploratory plots.

labs.title: What Changes Across Random Samples?
labs.scope: Sampling variation, standard errors and the central limit theorem.

labs.title: Does Class Size Predict Test Scores?
labs.scope: Simple OLS with robust inference.

labs.title: How Precise Is Our Estimate?
labs.scope: Confidence intervals, t tests and the difference between precision and importance.

labs.title: What Changes When We Add Controls?
labs.scope: Multiple regression, omitted variable bias and same-sample comparisons.

labs.title: Do Groups Have Different Wage Profiles?
labs.scope: Indicator variables, interactions and conditional comparisons.

labs.title: Modeling Percentage Changes and Curvature
labs.scope: Log transformations, polynomial terms and interpretation.

labs.title: Same Coefficient, Different Standard Error?
labs.scope: Heteroskedasticity and robust covariance estimation.

labs.title: Testing Several Claims Together
labs.scope: Joint restrictions, F/Wald tests and specification questions.

labs.title: Comparing Firms to Themselves
labs.scope: Panel data, fixed effects and cluster-robust uncertainty.

labs.title: Explaining Labor-Force Participation
labs.scope: Linear probability, logit/probit models and marginal effects.

labs.title: Estimating Effects with an Instrument
labs.scope: IV/2SLS, relevance, exclusion and weak-instrument limitations.

labs.title: Evaluating a Randomized Training Program
labs.scope: Random assignment, treatment contrasts and uncertainty.

labs.title: Before and After a Policy Reform
labs.scope: Difference-in-Differences, parallel trends and treatment-unit clustering.

labs.title: What Happens Around an Eligibility Cutoff?
labs.scope: Regression discontinuity, bandwidths, continuity and local effects.

labs.title: The Trap of Trending Series
labs.scope: Stationarity, unit roots and spurious regression.

labs.title: Accounting for Persistent Shocks
labs.scope: Serial correlation and HAC inference.

labs.title: Forecasting Inflation Without Looking Ahead
labs.scope: Autoregressive models, time-ordered evaluation and forecast errors.

labs.title: From Research Question to Finished Report
labs.scope: Capstone: design, data, estimation, diagnostics and reproducible reporting.

series_state: Twenty labs implemented and verified; separate student and instructor editions ready for user review.
